_comment: Valinor Smart Cuff GUI update manifest. This feed accepts only
v3.2.* releases and is intentionally separate from version.json.
The installed client needs no GitHub credential and fails silently offline.
notes:
Smart Cuff Valinor v3.2.87 displays calibrated NI-DAQ band-pass pressure in mmHg, including recording replay. The active pressure calibration is applied before filtering, without display-floor clipping.

Fixes the pulse capture callback exception that could stop NI sample processing. Valinor's Max 80–220 control profile and firmware rev27v-gauge-38 are retained.

Validation: 30 focused Valinor tests, real GUI NI callback checks, clean layout audit and mocked smoke check.
